title: Ohm Brew Core Twister 50/50 E-Liquid
description: Twister from Ohm Brew’s Core range of Freebase e-liquids is a nostalgic blend of tropical fruit in an ice swirl, just like the lollies you might remember. There is touch of sweet, tangy raspberry and zesty lime that makes this one of the most rounded flavours in Ohm Brew’s Core collection. Ohm Brew’s Core range recaptures the original magic of freebase nicotine e-liquids. Freebase nicotine is a form of nicotine with an alkaline formula, which offers more of a tactile ‘throat hit’ than nic salt e-liquids. Their throat sensation closely mimics the draw of a traditional cigarette, only the taste is far more delicious! Ohm Brew’s Core range of Freebase e-liquids are ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod kits.
